cornerstone.notes: Verified. Re-derived independently: quote found verbatim (whitespace-normalized) on the cited page in the 'RESTRICTIONS ON THE CORNERSTONE INVESTORS' section. Clause reads 'six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date', so the restriction includes the Listing Date and frees up ON the six-month anniversary. Date arithmetic re-checked in python: first_free_day = anniversary, last_restricted_day = anniversary - 1. Holder names cross-checked against the cornerstone table pages; all present. No longer (9/12/18/24/36-month) cornerstone variant found. Clause verbatim on p273; all 17 holder entries (Temasek, JPMAMAPL, CPE River, Ninety One Asia, Alibaba Investment, Huang River, GSAM, Manulife, Taikang Life, China Universal Investors, Bosera International, ICBC Wealth, IvyRock, GBAHIL, Metazone, Verition Fund, GMF and IRMF/Schonfeld) found on cornerstone pages 262-274.

controller_6m.notes: Verified. Re-derived independently: Rule 10.07(1)(a)-style clause located on the cited page, quote verbatim. Period 'commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of shareholding is made in this prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date' - explicit inclusive endpoint ON the six-month anniversary, so last_restricted_day = anniversary and first_free_day = anniversary + 1. Date arithmetic re-checked in python. Clause verbatim on p278 ('ending on the date which is 6 months from the Listing Date').

controller_12m.notes: Verified. Re-derived independently: second-period clause located on the cited page, quote verbatim. Six months commencing on the date on which the first period expires (the six-month anniversary of the Listing Date) runs to the day before the 12-month anniversary, so first_free_day = 12-month anniversary. Second period is conditional on ceasing to be a Controlling Shareholder; recorded as the standard conditional 12m controller restriction. Date arithmetic re-checked in python. Clause verbatim on p278 ('in the period of a further 6 months commencing on the date on which the period referred to in paragraph (a) above expires'); no 18C/18A references.
